Class AllureHtmlChrome

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.tools.io.AllureHtmlChrome
public final class AllureHtmlChrome extends Object
Resolves a Chromium binary for the single-file Allure HTML report. Order: CHROME_PATH, then the supplied system Chrome paths, then Playwright's browser cache only when that directory exists. A missing cache is skipped and is never listed. AllureManager still opens the report with the operating-system browser so a normal run does not start Chromium. Call this helper when a Chromium process is required.

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      public static Path resolve(String chromePath, List<Path> systemCandidates, Path playwrightCache, AllureHtmlChrome.ChromeLister playwrightLister) throws IOException
      Returns the first Chromium executable in the documented order.
      Parameters:
      chromePath - value of CHROME_PATH; blank means unset
      systemCandidates - system Chrome paths, already chosen by the caller
      playwrightCache - Playwright cache directory, usually under .cache/ms-playwright
      playwrightLister - lists Chrome binaries inside an existing cache; not called when the directory is absent
      Returns:
      the first Chromium executable
      Throws:
      IOException - when an existing Playwright cache cannot be read

    • listPlaywrightChrome

      public static List<Path> listPlaywrightChrome(Path cacheDir) throws IOException
      Lists Chrome executables under an existing Playwright cache. A missing directory yields an empty list and is not opened.
      Parameters:
      cacheDir - the Playwright cache directory
      Returns:
      regular files whose names are Chrome or Chromium executables
      Throws:
      IOException - when the directory exists but cannot be walked
